headline: IVANHOE ELECTRIC SANTA CRUZ COPPER PFS: $3.5B NPV, 30% IRR, 75,000 TPY — ALL PERMITS IN HAND, BOX CUT STARTS OCTOBER
snippet: Ivanhoe Electric Inc. (TSX: IE) released its 2026 S-K 1300 Preliminary Feasibility Study for the Santa Cruz Copper Project in Arizona on September 23, defining after-tax NPV of US$3.5 billion and a 30.0% IRR at COMEX copper near $6.79/lb — with initial capital of $1.43 billion and cash operating costs of just $1.47 per pound of copper. The mine plan calls for 75,000 tonnes of average annual copper cathode production over the first 15 years via heap leach processing, with mine access using The Robbins Company's Crossover Tunnel Boring Machine — a technique that compresses the construction timeline relative to conventional decline development. All city, county, and state permits have been obtained; box cut development commences in October 2026. At a moment when global copper mine supply growth is structurally flat and Anglo Teck is forming to secure 1.2 million tonnes per year, a fully permitted, high-grade US underground copper mine with a 30% IRR entering construction is the most significant domestic copper development news in the current cycle.

headline: GOLIATH RESOURCES COMPLETES 48,443m AT SUREBET — 100% HIT RATE IN 97 HOLES; 2.01 km² GOLDEN TRIANGLE FOOTPRINT STILL OPEN
snippet: Goliath Resources Limited (TSXV: GOT) completed its 2026 drill campaign at the Surebet Discovery in BC's Golden Triangle on September 22 — 48,443 metres in 97 holes across 94 days with a 100% hit rate, meaning every single hole intersected quartz-sulphide mineralization, and 85% returned visible gold. The total Surebet footprint grew 12% to 2.01 km² with the Golden Gate Zone expanding 38% to 1.17 km² and the Bonanza Zone growing 19% to 1.51 km², both still open. Grade highlights include 14.28 g/t AuEq over 4.32 metres in the high-grade northeastern wedge and a confirmed Big Bulk Zone benchmark of 1.97 g/t AuEq over 33 metres. Critically, 83-88 drill holes remain pending assays — fewer than 10% of the 2026 results have been released, meaning this program will drive news flow through Q4 2026 and into Q1 2027. A drill program that finishes 48,000 metres without a single missed hole, in one of the world's most prolific orogenic gold belts, is the kind of geological consistency that precedes a maiden resource estimate.

headline: CAMBRIA GOLD PREMIER HITS 166.2 g/t Au AND 3,383 g/t Ag OVER 3.1m — COPPER SPIN-OUT ANNOUNCED FOR SEPARATE U.S. PROJECT
snippet: Cambria Gold Mines Inc. (TSXV: CAMB) reported hole P26U-0095 at the historic Premier Gold Project near Stewart, BC returned 166.22 g/t gold and 3,383 g/t silver over 3.1 metres — including 467 g/t Au and 9,510 g/t Ag over 1.1 metres — from 6,923 metres across 70 surface and underground infill drill holes. Premier is one of the highest-grade historic gold-silver deposits in Canada's northwest corridor; these infill results confirm the continuity of bonanza-grade mineralisation as the company expands its program to 42,000 planned metres and begins drilling the Silver Coin deposit (initial results expected October 2026). Separately, Cambria announced a spin-out plan for an unrelated US copper project, creating a clean gold-focused vehicle at Premier while unlocking copper exposure for existing shareholders — a capital structure simplification that has historically preceded institutional re-rating of the primary asset.

headline: JAPAN GOLD FORMS $50M ALLIANCE WITH SOLIDCORE — 50% PREMIUM EQUITY; OR ROYALTIES EXERCISES OPTION TO LIFT NSR TO 2%
snippet: Japan Gold Corp. (TSXV: JG) announced a strategic exploration alliance on September 23 with Solidcore Resources plc, under which Solidcore commits US$25 million in exploration funding across five areas of the Japan Gold portfolio, while closing C$9.5 million in equity (plus C$1M from Equinox Partners) at a 50% premium to market — a signal of institutional conviction rarely seen on junior exploration deals. Combined with a simultaneous US$3 million royalty exercise by OR Royalties lifting its NSR interest from 1.5% to 2% across all properties, the total committed capital package reaches C$50 million. Solidcore appointed two nominees to Japan Gold's board. The 50% premium on the equity component is the most telling datapoint: it values Japan Gold's 22-project portfolio at a level its market cap did not, suggesting Solidcore's technical diligence found something the market has yet to price. Japan covers one of the world's least-drilled Tier 1 jurisdictions for gold — the premium entry is a directional signal worth tracking.

headline: COPPER GIANT MOCOA HITS 804m AT 0.56% CuEq INCLUDING 103m AT 1.07% CuEq — FOURTH DRILL ON WESTERN FLANK; PEA ON TRACK Q4 2026
snippet: Copper Giant Resources Corp. (CSE: CGAU) released results from four drill holes at Mocoa, its flagship copper-molybdenum porphyry in Putumayo, Colombia, on September 22 — headlined by infill daughter hole MD-073 returning 804 metres at 0.56% CuEq including a higher-grade core of 103 metres at 1.07% CuEq (0.57% Cu and 0.095% Mo), plus MD-067 returning 165 metres at 0.67% CuEq and MD-071 returning 184 metres at 0.62% CuEq, both ending in mineralisation. The Mocoa deposit has now demonstrated over 1,100 metres of vertical continuity; a fourth drill rig is mobilising to the western flank — an area where the lateral extent of the porphyry system has not been defined, meaning the resource footprint is likely to grow. A Preliminary Economic Assessment is targeted for Q4 2026, and Frank Giustra highlighted Mocoa in a recent interview as one of his top Colombian copper-gold plays. At current copper prices, a sub-$1.50/lb operating cost Colombian porphyry with a 12.7 billion pound resource base warrants close attention ahead of the PEA.

headline: KINCORA FINDS FOUR NEW PORPHYRY COMPLEXES IN 40km BELT — AngloGold Ashanti Can Spend A$100M Under JV; Province-Scale NJB Emerges
snippet: Kincora Copper Ltd. (ASX: KCC) reported on September 22 that its 2026 scout drilling at Nevertire South — operated under an earn-in agreement where AngloGold Ashanti can invest up to A$100 million across five adjacent licences in the Northern Junee-Narromine Belt (NJNB) — has identified four potential new porphyry complexes within a prospective strike exceeding 40 kilometres, with volcanics and intrusions showing continuity across the full belt. The four scout holes at Nevertire South's southern strike all intersected copper and gold grades indicative of proximity to porphyry system centres, escalating the exploration from single-prospect to province-scale. Scout drilling has also resumed at Nyngan, targeting the Ace of Spades and Gerar prospects with five to eight holes planned. A major strategic partner (AngloGold Ashanti) controlling a A$100M exploration budget in a district that now shows four new complexes across 40 kilometres of strike is the infrastructure that turns a promising porphyry into a potential district-scale copper-gold play.

headline: REVIVAL GOLD 64% THROUGH MERCUR INFILL — 0.92 g/t Au OVER 33.5m; 9 MILLION TONNES LEGACY HEAP LEACH ADDED TO PFS SCOPE
snippet: Revival Gold Inc. (TSXV: RVG) reported on September 22 that its 2026 infill program at the Mercur Gold Project in Utah is 64% complete (approximately 11,600 metres in 119 holes), with recent highlights including RM26-213 returning 0.92 g/t gold over 33.5 metres and RM26-220 returning 0.75 g/t over 29.0 metres — bulk-tonnage grades consistent with the resource model the company is converting from Inferred to Measured and Indicated in support of a Preliminary Feasibility Study targeted for Q1 2027. A fourth auger rig arriving by month-end will investigate approximately 9 million tonnes of legacy run-of-mine heap leach material stored in three pads at Mercur — potential reprocessing feed that could materially alter the project's economics by front-loading recoverable gold into the early mine plan. At $4,300+ gold, a Utah open-pit gold project in the PFS stage with a low-grade but large-tonnage resource profile and legacy heap leach optionality represents the kind of near-development asset that mid-tier producers have been actively seeking.

headline: GREENLAND MINES SURGES 200%+ AS US-DENMARK PACT BARS CHINESE RARE EARTH INVESTMENT — SARFARTOQ HOLDS 34% OF EX-CHINA NdPr SUPPLY POTENTIAL
snippet: The formal signing of the US-Denmark-Greenland Security Agreement at UNGA on September 22 — which bars Chinese entities from making sensitive investments in Greenland's strategic resources without US written approval — sent shares of Greenland Mines Inc. (GRML) up more than 200% on the announcement as investors repriced the strategic value of its Sarfartoq neodymium-praseodymium rare earth project. Sarfartoq carries potential NdPr resources equivalent to 34% of all NdPr oxide currently refined outside China at 2025 consumption levels — positioning it as the most strategically significant rare earth project in allied supply chain discussions. A North Atlantic Critical Metals Corridor linking Greenland's resources to allied processing infrastructure is being proposed alongside the pact. For retail investors who have watched Western rare earth supply initiatives fail at the processing bottleneck, this security pact is meaningfully different from prior announcements: it is a governmental commitment to exclude Chinese capital from the supply corridor, not just a statement of intent to develop domestic supply.

headline: OR ROYALTIES: FIRST GOLD POURED AT CUIÚ CUIÚ IN BRAZIL; AMULSAR MINE IN ARMENIA APPROACHING Q4 PRODUCTION — PORTFOLIO ACTIVATING
snippet: OR Royalties Inc. (TSX: OR) confirmed on September 23 that first gold was produced at the Cuiú Cuiú project in Brazil on September 10, 2026 — where OR holds a 1% NSR royalty on Cabral Gold's development — with commercial production ramp-up targeted for Q4 2026. Separately, the Amulsar Gold Mine in Armenia is approaching first production, adding a second new royalty stream to OR's portfolio within the same quarter. The dual activation is significant for royalty investors: OR Royalties' NAV is driven by when assets transition from development-stage optionality to cash-generating NSRs, and the simultaneous activation of two assets in Q4 2026 — alongside the company's simultaneous exercise of an additional 0.5% NSR on Japan Gold's entire portfolio for US$3 million — signals a portfolio maturation that was not yet priced into OR's September trading range. For retail investors building royalty company exposure alongside direct junior equity, OR's Q4 activation events are the catalysts that compress the gap between NAV and market cap.
